title: Node registration handshake
description: Boot a real isolated gateway with an offline-seeded credential store and drive the node daemon's own transport helper over a plain websocket. Proves a refused node.connect surfaces its gateway code and message instead of hanging on an open socket, a non-node credential is refused at auth.connect, and a correctly owned node is listed by nodes.list at the gateway protocol version only after its registration ACK, then unlisted when its socket closes.

handshake.intent: Registration refusal (AUTH_FORBIDDEN native-owner mismatch) is observable on the daemon side and the machine stays out of nodes.list; a person credential presented as clientKind node is refused with a node-subject action; the owned node's node.connect ACK precedes its nodes.list entry with versionMatch true, and closing the socket removes it.
